recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future publisher or terminology rendering regression causes CLD filter rows to omit display text again.
issue_request: FHIR-10303 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Vocabulary change request asking that Content Logical Definition rendering for intensionally defined value sets include descriptions for filter code values, especially SNOMED CT is-a filters in the historical substance-code example. The Jira resolution says the problem was already fixed.
initial_application: No current source-history commit explicitly mentions FHIR-10303. The relevant substance-code source was already changed before the FHIR-10303 vote by commit 8f5579319910f584e8044f2fa17414395ab9f346, which added human-readable SNOMED descriptions for the 105590001 and 373873005 filters while applying FHIR-12239-related SNOMED CT recommendations.
additional_context: Substance and ValueSet are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The current source/substance/valueset-substance-code.xml still describes the remaining SNOMED filter as 105590001 (Substance (substance)). FHIR-19295 later removed the 373873005 pharmaceutical/biologic product filter from substance-code, explaining why the current value set has only one of the two filters shown in the original FHIR-10303 example. Current build, R5, and R4 rendered pages show CLD filter rows with code descriptions.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source and generated/published CLD surface already satisfy the issue request, and adding redundant prose would not materially improve the specification.

related_jiras.note: Its 2017 SNOMED CT recommendation work appears to be the source-history change that made FHIR-10303 already fixed.
It intentionally removed the 373873005 pharmaceutical/biologic product filter from the Substance value set while preserving the display text pattern for the remaining filter.
